comment: GO TO OFFICE HOURS! Even if you aren't necessarily struggling, they're always there to help and it pays off! Super sweet professor and there are plenty of chances to bring your grade up if you need to. They're a little bit of a harsh grader on tests and quizzes but pulled through on the final! Homework is optional.

Vic is the best! Lectures were always organized and full of important material. There were lots of assignments that could help your grade easily, so tests did not hit as hard. Vic was also very clear about what they expected you to know on the tests and always gave extra study material. I highly recommend!
VIc is a super sweet professor and knows her stuff. Like most of them, she's not a scary math professor, but I was not afraid to ask questions in class. Definitely would recommend taking her!

Vic is by far the best professor in the mathematics department. They are so kind and helpful. As someone who has struggled in math classes previously, Vic has made me, not only able to understand but enjoy the material.

The kindest professor in the mathematics department. This professor teaches by the book, and you won't be under a lot of pressure to take her class. She is negotiable sometimes and you can always go ask questions during office hour - definitely approachable.
